title: prefill-decode-pipeline-chunked-speculative-stage-overlap-kernel-scheduler-kv-cache-optimizations
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: reduce end-to-end token latency and cost for mixed workloads by optimizing the prefill vs decode pipeline boundary. This PR implements a combination of chunked prefill, speculative prefill, and tighter stage overlap with a new kernel-aware scheduler and KV-cache locality improvements. Goal is to improve throughput on batched requests while preserving p50 latency SLOs for single-request short sequences. Summary of changes: (1) Chunked prefill: split long prefill sequences into tunable chunks so prefill work can be overlapped with early decode work; added heuristics to pick chunk sizes based on sequence length histograms. (2) Speculative prefill: speculative execution of next-prefill chunk for bursts where decode latency is likely to stall the pipeline; speculative results are reconciled with actual outputs and cached. (3) Stage overlap: reworked the runtime pipeline to allow prefill kernels and decode kernels to execute concurrently on different CUDA streams with careful KV cache handoffs. (4) Kernel scheduler: new micro-scheduler that prefers kernels with higher throughput potential while avoiding KV cache thrashing; scheduler incorporates per-kernel latency estimates from profiling tables. (5) KV cache locality: introduce per-GPU hot-region caching and LRU trimming tuned for chunked-prefill patterns to reduce cross-GPU KV fetches for multi-request batches. (6) Continuous batching adjustments: adapt batching timeouts to account for speculative prefill so we do not increase tail latency. Checklist: - [x] Design doc (linked ENG-4128) - [x] Microbench harness + synthetic workloads - [x] Optimistic rollback path for speculative prefill - [x] CI + perf regression checks - [x] Runtime feature gate behind "prefill_overlap_opt" for safety Backwards compatibility: feature gated and disabled by default for Dedicated/Private unless explicitly enabled in config. Rollout plan: staged rollout on canaries in eu-west-1 then broader rollout after 48h perf analysis.

benchmark_summary: Internal microbench: short-seq p50 latency -18% on RTX-A100 clusters when feature enabled (single-request, batch=1). Throughput (tokens/s) +22% for mixed-length workloads with batching enabled. KV cache remote fetches reduced by ~40% on multi-request batches. End-to-end token cost estimate down ~8% for typical customer workload profile.
tests_and_validation: Added synthetic workload tests covering chunk boundaries, speculative reconciliation, and KV eviction storms. Extended continuous-batching e2e to validate no tail latency regressions. Ran canary in eu-west-1 on 50k requests; observed no errors and metrics aligned with benchmarks.
release_notes: Performance: improved prefill-decode overlap via chunked/speculative prefill and a kernel-aware scheduler; reduces p50 latency and increases throughput. Feature gated behind 'prefill_overlap_opt' and off by default.
notes_for_ops: Operational knobs: chunk_size (default auto), speculative_depth (default 1), hot_region_size_mb (default 64), kv_eviction_threshold (default 0.8). Monitor metrics: prefill_reconciliation_rate, kv_remote_fetches, scheduler_queue_latency. Canary rollout recommended before enabling cluster-wide.
human_readable_summary: This PR reduces latency and increases throughput by overlapping prefill and decode with chunking and speculative execution, adding a kernel-aware scheduler and improving KV cache locality. Changes are feature-gated and validated with microbenchmarks and canary runs.
